source: Explicit FROM callback scalar PATH/QUEUE_TYPE and collection-bank results, including generic outer ARRAY dimensions and compiled forwarding
values: Exact owned runtime values or canonical type/value JSON; named components and PATH layouts stay exact
capture: Bound complete logical data before receiver selection or later arguments; detach nodes/headers/entries and queue buffers; keep partial markers, queue IDs/order/counter
lifetime: Existing callback generator checkpoints/pause/resume/stop/abort and source frame cleanup; preserve earlier callback effects on invalid result
cli: Generated output and project --external-collections provide fixed values only; source arguments evaluated normally but not inspected or written by fixed callbacks
input: Strict optionally BOM-prefixed UTF-8 JSON, at most 4 MiB and 128 distinct case-insensitive program/function bindings; reject state/trace aliases
bounds: 32767 PATH leaves/queue entries/bank units; PATH totals before node allocation, banks before cell allocation; ordinary rank and data-depth limits
persistence: Existing logical state only; callbacks, private frames, live buffers and suspended calls omitted; input bindings supplied again on replay
boundary: FILE/embedded resources/generic queue codecs/UNINIT/ordinary data callback contracts and exact linked types unchanged; no native ABI/compiler/controller/strict equivalence
